spans.s:
स्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sewn, stitched.
 m. (-तः) A sack.
 E. षिव् to sew, aff. क्त ।

स्यूति f. (-तिः)
 1. Sewing, stitching, working with needle and thread.
2. Offspring, lineage.
 3. A sack, a bag.
 E. षिव् to sew, aff. क्तिन् ।

स्यून m. (-नः)
 1. The sun.
 2. A ray of light.
 3. A sack, a bag.
 E. षिव् to
sew, Unādi aff. नक्, and यूच् substituted for the last two radical
letters; also with the vowel of the augment changed स्योन ।

स्यूम m. (-मः) A ray of light.
 n. (-मं)
 1.

. A ray of light.
 E. षिव
to sew, मक् Unādi aff., and यूच् substituted for the radical finals.
